rows.en:
…!?

Grr… Ozuma! You've betrayed us!? Damn it!!
Ozuma…!? What incredible power!
Ah, that black one…!?
Ah, that black one…!?
The ultrasonic whistle is complete!
Excellent, now make a bloody sacrifice of those Space Sheriffs!
Beast Alien Doubleman!!

Ha ha ha…

This Doubleman's ultrasonic whistle is built to work on Space Sheriffs! Suffer, and die!!
Nuoooh…
Senpai…!?
Senpai…!?
I've come back from Australia, on the trail of a new evil organization, Gorgom!
And I've come back from America for the same reason!
Gorgom?
Gorgom?
That's right! The dark secret society Gorgom, who are after that black Kamen Rider!
An evil organization scheming in the shadows to destroy civilization and build a world of cyborgs! We will never allow it!!
Dad… I'll save Nobuhiko, I swear it! Watch over me, Dad!!
Dad… I'll save Nobuhiko, I swear it! Watch over me, Dad!!
How could this happen… The Century King Black Sun has completely turned against us…

There is no need to fret…

Lords of the Three Archpriests, is there not one more candidate for Century King?
Exactly. We need only make Nobuhiko Akizuki the Century King… Isn't it simple?
Kotaro Minami, now Kamen Rider BLACK, carries the King Stone inside his body. It will not be so simple!
Leave it to us, Lords of the Three Archpriests… We of the battle-fleet nation Naager will lend you our full strength as well.
Bring down the hammer on mankind!

Everyone, please forgive me. I was always being hunted, so I couldn't trust anyone…

I am Ben, son of Dr. Barnes, the nuclear physicist from Planet Lake. Hikaru is an android whose purpose is to guard me, too.
Madou was trying to use the Radiation Clean System for military purposes. Thanks to all of you, we were saved.
What will you do now?
I'm going back to Planet Lake, and I'm going to rebuild it to be like this beautiful Earth.
That's a great idea! Rebuilding Planet Iga is my dream too! Let's both do our best!
Thank you so very much.
And then… what will you do, Ozuma?

I'm going back to Planet Kyuri too, to fight the Dark Aliens!

The Dark Aliens are terrifying creatures under Fuuma's command! But I will fight!
That's right… You've gained that power, and you've done it admirably.
That's right… Having a home planet you can rebuild… I really envy you.
Take care… Be careful on your way!
Thank you… You've done so much for us.
Well then, farewell… Goodbye!
I'm a Century King of Gorgom! So… I don't have the right to fight alongside all of you…

The right…? Do you need something like that?

I…

I too am a man who was once called an enemy…

But… now here I am, fighting alongside everyone! What you need isn't the right! It's a strong heart that loves justice!

…I think so too.

Besides, "Kamen Rider"… is a title given to warriors of justice.

The right, huh…

Put that way, I don't have it either. But isn't what you need not some right, but a strong heart that loves justice?
That's right… "Kamen Rider"… is a title given to warriors of justice, you know.
Kamen Rider…?
That's right… You're a cyborg too, a Kamen Rider!
If a Rider needs any right at all… there's only one!
A heart that loves justice and peace!
We believe that where there is justice, victory will always follow! That's what we Kamen Riders are!
Senpai…

Now, now… Enough of the heavy talk.

We've got a reliable new friend, and Takeshi and the others are back! Isn't that cause to celebrate… Now the Amigo Squad's fighting strength is stronger than ever!

You know… I really am glad I run Amigo! You kids are my pride and joy!
Mr. Tachibana…
Kotaro Minami was made into a cyborg by the dark secret society Gorgom…
But… he too overcame his grief and became a Kamen Rider, fighting evil organizations for humanity's freedom!
To shatter Gorgom's ambitions and to save the captive Nobuhiko, Kotaro Minami… Kamen Rider BLACK fights on!!
Joji Yuki, Riderman, is present / Joji Yuki, Riderman, is absent
Nuoooh…
Kuh… Damn it!
Waaaagh…
Kyaah…

The secret base of the Terrestrial Defense Force's Far East Branch, built underground at the foot of Mt. Fuji.
In its conference room, an emergency meeting of senior officers, led by Director Yamaoka, was under way…

uncertain: U06910/U06911/U06949: 先輩 kept as "Senpai" (the junior Riders addressing their seniors); "Sempai" or a name would also work.
U06912/U06913: Rider 1 from Australia, Rider 2 from America (as in the source).
U06921/U06924: 三神官様 rendered "Lords of the Three Archpriests" (Apfaron addressing all three); could be "my lords the Three Archpriests".
U06926: [ja] — "too" kept literally; Ben is not an android himself, so "too" may mean "also (has a secret)".
U06940: [HERO2] says he was once called an enemy (route-specific backstory); translated literally.
U06941: [HERO4] "…だと思います" follows the [HERO2] line; rendered "I think so too".
U06955: debug/branch label with two options; kept both joined with " / ".
U06963-U06966: ギガントを全て倒せ rendered "all Gigants" (several Gigant units).

by analogy with 戦闘員ミラクラー = Miracler Soldier
